title: The Libreswan pluto daemon dereferences a NULL pointer when a CERT payload is received with an empty PKCS#7 payload,…
description: A vulnerability in the Libreswan pluto daemon causes it to dereference a NULL pointer when processing a CERT payload containing an empty PKCS#7 payload. This results in the daemon crashing and restarting, leading to a denial of service. The flaw arises because the NSS function SEC_PKCS7GetCertificateList() does not detect an empty list within a non-empty PKCS#7 payload. No authentication is required to exploit this issue, and remote code execution is not possible.
